test_title: PYST 49: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: D, N, U, L and O are standing in a straight line facing north. N is standing to the immediate right of D, who is at the end. O is standing to the immediate left of L, who is not at the end. Who is standing to the immediate left of O?
solution:
**D, N, U, L and O** are standing in a straight line facing north.

1. N is standing to the immediate right of D, who is at the end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d976e4f406cd41d78ba701b06662c5b8da9ec796d3123e4b919e71cd8e619d1.png] 

3. O is standing to the immediate left of L, who is not at the end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cc7ec03bacb5d3378458b802c378b2811765038d6811153aaf4fb782aa7f696.png] 

U, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/147767bc3a3cfdd2deab1f25cbf3c11840b16caecb2c90db7e6b3d861a568b75.png] 

Clearly, N is standing to the immediate left of O.

Hence, '**N**' is the correct answer.
